question: After estimating finite-species rho uncertainty from split halves, does the two-axis lineage-memory architecture persist in the high-support AusTraits subset?
population: 158 matched positive-numeric log systems with prune-native tips >=40.

sampling_variance.half_estimator: For each of three deterministic split replicates, compute (rho_A-rho_B)^2/2 as the half-sample error variance contribution under equal independent halves.
sampling_variance.full_data_conversion: Approximate full-data sampling variance as one half of half-sample variance, yielding mean((rho_A-rho_B)^2)/4 per system.
sampling_variance.interpretation: This is an empirical split-half approximation, not an exact analytic variance estimator.

model: rho_ft ~ intercept + family random effect + trait random effect + system random effect, with the split-half sampling variance added as known diagonal observation variance.
estimation: REML by direct Gaussian covariance optimization.
outputs: sampling share of mean total variance
role: post-outcome measurement-error sensitivity; cannot reclassify prospective decisions
hard_nonclaims: Three split replicates provide a noisy per-system variance estimate.
The inverse-information scaling from half to full sample is an approximation.
The system component may still contain unmodeled estimation error and biological heterogeneity.
